quotes.text: Showing up is the hardest rep. You already did it.
Small steps, taken daily, add up to big changes.
Today's effort is tomorrow's energy.
You don't have to be fast. You just have to start.
Five minutes of movement beats zero minutes of waiting.
Be proud of the days you almost skipped but didn't.
Progress is not a straight line, and that's okay.
Move because you can, not because you must.
A gentle workout still counts.
Your future self is cheering for you right now.
Rest is part of the plan, not a break from it.
Drink some water, take a deep breath, and begin.
Consistency is quiet. It shows up every day.
Don't compare your chapter one to someone else's chapter twenty.
Every walk is a win.
Good habits are built one ordinary day at a time.
Your body is your teammate. Treat it kindly.
Strong is built slowly and kindly.
A slow day is still a day forward.
Make today a little more active than yesterday.
Energy grows when you use it.
Done is better than perfect, especially on workout days.
Celebrate the small wins. They are the real milestones.
Fresh air, easy pace, clear mind.
A short walk can turn a whole day around.
Skip the guilt. Pick up where you left off.
Healthy habits are a gift you give yourself every day.
Stretch a little, smile a little, move a little.
Feeling tired is a reason to start gently, not a reason to stop.
Every step you take is a vote for the person you want to be.
Take care of your body. It carries you everywhere.
Finish what you start today, even if it's small.
Motivation sparks it. Routine keeps it burning.
Be patient with your progress. Roots grow before leaves.
Choose the stairs, choose the walk, choose yourself.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Nothing great was ever achieved without enthusiasm.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: Do the thing, and you shall have the power.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: Exercise and temperance can preserve something of our early strength even in old age.
quotes.author: Cicero

quotes.text: They can conquer who believe they can.
quotes.author: Virgil

quotes.text: Slow and steady wins the race.
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.text: Lost time is never found again.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: Well done is better than well said.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Well begun is half done.
quotes.author: Proverb

quotes.text: Rome wasn't built in a day.
quotes.author: Proverb
